issues.description: Fixed an issue where high CPU utilization occurred on one of the CPU cores.
Fixed an issue where Geneve ingress traffic did not use the correct public IP address for return traffic.
Fixed an issue where GlobalProtect users intermittently received incorrect private IP addresses after connecting to a gateway behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB).

Fixed an issue where no warning message was displayed during commits for improperly formatted FQDN or IP address values in the GlobalProtect Enforcer configuration. This fix requires a compatible content version on the firewall.

Fixed an issue where multiple firewalls experienced high management CPU utilization after upgrading to an affected release due to repeated index regeneration occurring every 15 minutes, which caused periodic CPU spikes above 90%.

Fixed an issue where the session timer for a custom application did not transition from the initial 3-way handshake timer to the application timeout when out-of-order 3-way handshake packets were detected.
Fixed an issue where the /pancfg partition on the Azure Cloud NGFW reached 100% utilization, which caused commit failures.
Fixed an intermittent issue where traffic logs were truncated when they were forwarded using a TCP syslog configuration due to the forwarding queue capacity being exceeded.
Fixed an issue on airgapped firewalls where cloud connection errors flooded the system logs.
